deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

display_name.description:
A user-assigned name for this group, used only for display
purposes.
display_name.rationale: Display metadata with no security impact.

filter.description:
The filter used to determine which monitored resources
belong to this group.
filter.rationale: Functional selector with no direct security impact; the filter defines membership, not access control.

is_cluster.description:
If true, the members of this group are considered to be a
cluster. The system can perform additional analysis on
groups that are clusters.
is_cluster.rationale: Analytical setting with no security impact.

parent_name.description:
The name of the group's parent, if it has one. The format is
"projects/{project_id_or_number}/groups/{group_id}". For
groups with no parent, parentName is the empty string, "".
parent_name.rationale: Structural hierarchy field with no security impact.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Organisational field, not a security control.
